highlights.text: It is distinguished from earlier dip pens by using an internal reservoir to hold ink, eliminating the need to repeatedly dip the pen in an inkwell during use.
The pen draws ink from the reservoir through a feed
employ removable reservoirs in the form of pre-filled ink
There is compelling evidence that a working fountain pen was constructed and used during the Renaissance by artist and inventor Leonardo da Vinci.
